preconditions.description: The number of elements N is between 3 and 1000 inclusive.
The number of queries Q is between 1 and 1000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(B) == N and all(len(row) == N for row in B)
preconditions.description: The initial matrix B is an N x N matrix.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= B[i][j] <= 5000 for i in range(N) for j in range(N))
preconditions.description: All initial matrix entries are non-negative integers up to 5000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= p <= N for p in query_rows)
preconditions.description: Each query specifies a valid row/column index p between 1 and N.

preconditions.expression: all(all(0 <= val <= 5000 for val in F) for F in query_values_list)
preconditions.description: All new values provided in queries are non-negative integers up to 5000.
It is guaranteed that a valid sequence A exists for the initial matrix and after every update.

postconditions.description: The output contains exactly Q + 1 lines.

postconditions.expression: all(len(line.split()) == N for line in output_lines)
postconditions.description: Each output line contains exactly N space-separated integers.
The first element of every output sequence is 0.

postconditions.expression: all(abs(seq[i] - seq[j]) == current_B[i][j] for i in range(N) for j in range(N) for seq, current_B in zip(parsed_outputs, all_matrices))
postconditions.description: For each output sequence and its corresponding matrix state, the absolute difference between any two elements equals the corresponding matrix entry.

postconditions.expression: all(not any((seq2[k] < seq1[k]) for k in range(N)) for seq1, seq2 in zip(parsed_outputs, [None] + parsed_outputs[1:]))
postconditions.description: Each output sequence is the lexicographically smallest valid sequence for its corresponding matrix state.
